question: How do I replace a faulty oven igniter in my electric oven?
answer: To replace a faulty oven igniter, first disconnect the power to the oven and remove the back panel. Then, locate the igniter and disconnect the electrical connection. Next, remove the igniter screw and gently pull the igniter out. Clean the igniter electrode and replace it with a new one. Finally, reconnect the electrical connection and replace the back panel.
steps: Disconnect the power to the oven.
Locate the igniter and disconnect the electrical connection.
Remove the igniter screw and gently pull the igniter out.
Clean the igniter electrode and replace it with a new one.
Reconnect the electrical connection and replace the back panel.
safety_info: Risk of electrical shock from exposed wiring. Wear gloves and safety glasses when working with electrical components.
tips: Use a screwdriver with a magnetic tip to pick up small screws.
Use a wire brush to clean the igniter electrode.
